newsitem.title: UK: Carlton shares buck weaker market.
newsitem.headline: Carlton shares buck weaker market.

text.p: Shares in Carlton Communications bucked a weaker UK stockmarket on Tuesday, adding 15p to be trading at 487-1/2p by late morning.
Having peaked at 535p on June 17, Carlton shares slipped back to 443p on July 24 before recovering in recent sessions.
Meetings between the company and analysts this week have been reasonably positive though with little to prompt any radical changes to forecasts, said analysts.
"We are seeing better indications of advertising for the final quarter of the year and MediaWeek last week was reporting that October was looking quite strong," said one.

"The delay in Channel 5 is also good news for all channel 3 operators. Carlton has underperformed the market quite substantially over the last quarter amid worries about levels of TV advertising and the impact of Channel 5 so we're just seeing a bit of a recovery from that," he said. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8712
